newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 climbs to record after holiday.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 climbs to record after holiday.

text.p: The London stock market extended its record-breaking run in an abbreviated session Friday, returning from the Christmas holiday to hit a new peak.
The FTSE index of blue-chip share prices rose as high as 4,102.9 before ending down 1.5 points at 4,091.0 at 1230 GMT. The previous record intraday high of 4,100 was set last Friday.
Volume was thin, with only 111.7 million shares recorded.
